{{Top|leg}}
A '''heavy weapons detail''' was the term given to a small [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] formation, usually a three-man detachment armed with a [[Medium repeating blaster/Legends|medium repeating blaster]]. They were used to augment Army [[Squad/Legends|squads]] and add firepower to the formation. Heavy weapons details were defined by the weapon they carried, either a medium repeating blaster, or a [[Heavy repeating blaster/Legends|heavy repeating blaster]].
